name: EverHustle-FrontEnd
description: EverHustle is an open-sourced productivity web application that aims to help society with various ways of boosting their productivity

paragraphs: The corona-virus pandemic has resulted in a drop in productivity for most people, they are not accustomed to doing ‘work from home’. People are witnessing drop in their productivity. To help people regain their potential, EverHustle is developed. EverHustle is an open-sourced productivity web application that tries to help society with various ways of boosting their productivity thorugh it's features.
features: Set daily, weekly and monthly goals
Keep a track of your productive time
Postive articles to keep you motivated
Email authentication preventing phishing and forged emails
